boundary.constant_state: float registers come only from observed Set*ShaderConstantF writes intersected with CTAB ranges
boundary.instance_stream_identity: non-zero stream pointer generation plus offset/stride is capture-local repeated-instance evidence only
boundary.reflection_policy: missing CTAB reflection is partial/ambiguous and can never produce strong-capture-local
boundary.shader_pair: captured VS/PS byte hashes are exact; they do not select an FXO permutation without unique runtime proof
boundary.strong_capture_local: shader generations, stream-0 VB, IB, CTAB reflection, reflected float constants and sampler bindings all resolved
boundary.target_filter: draws require a bound pixel-shader byte SHA-256 present in the supplied target inventory
boundary.texture_identity: CTAB sampler stages preserve texture pointer generations; shared textures do not imply BMT identity
boundary.transform_name_matching: world/model/object/instance CTAB names are diagnostic only; matrix semantics and scene identity are not inferred

buffer_payload.required_for: exact VB/IB payload equality against static IMB data

resource_path_sha_identity.minimal_missing_event: resource_path + resource_sha256 on one resource event

shader_creation_use_identity.required_for: shader byte identity and creation generation

draw_records.reason: per-draw constants and bindings are stored in the full evidence report
